```{r}
set.seed(42)
quiet_output <- TRUE
quiet_cat <- function(...) {
  if (!quiet_output) cat(...)
}

n_detected_cores <- tryCatch(parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE), error = function(e) NA_integer_)
if (length(n_detected_cores) == 0 || is.na(n_detected_cores)) {
  n_detected_cores <- tryCatch(parallel::detectCores(), error = function(e) 1L)
}
if (length(n_detected_cores) == 0 || is.na(n_detected_cores)) {
  n_detected_cores <- 1L
}
n_parallel_workers <- max(1L, as.integer(n_detected_cores) - 1L)

parallel_map_with_progress <- function(X, FUN, ..., workers = n_parallel_workers,
                                       progress_label = NULL, chunk_size = NULL) {
  n <- length(X)
  if (n == 0L) return(list())
  workers <- as.integer(workers)
  if (length(workers) == 0 || is.na(workers) || workers < 1L) {
    workers <- 1L
  }
  if (is.null(chunk_size)) {
    chunk_size <- max(1L, workers)
  }
  chunk_size <- as.integer(chunk_size)
  if (length(chunk_size) == 0 || is.na(chunk_size) || chunk_size < 1L) {
    chunk_size <- 1L
  }
  
  results <- vector("list", n)
  chunk_starts <- seq.int(1L, n, by = chunk_size)
  
  if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
    cat(progress_label, "\n")
    pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
    on.exit(close(pb), add = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (chunk_start in chunk_starts) {
    idx <- chunk_start:min(chunk_start + chunk_size - 1L, n)
    chunk <- X[idx]
    chunk_start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    chunk_res <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" || workers <= 1L || length(chunk) == 1L) {
      lapply(chunk, FUN, ...)
    } else {
      parallel::mclapply(
        chunk, FUN, ...,
        mc.cores = min(workers, length(chunk)),
        mc.preschedule = TRUE,
        mc.set.seed = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    results[idx] <- chunk_res
    
    if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
      utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb, max(idx))
      elapsed_chunk <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start_time, units = "secs")), 1)
      cat(sprintf("  completed %d-%d / %d (chunk %.1fs)\n", min(idx), max(idx), n, elapsed_chunk))
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
    cat(sprintf(" %s done.\n", progress_label))
  }
  
  results
}

make_panel <- function(df, years, baseline_years, spec = c("reduced", "contemporaneous"),
                       drop_city_ids = NULL, keep_city_ids = NULL) {
  spec <- match.arg(spec)
  years <- sort(unique(as.integer(years)))
  baseline_years <- sort(unique(as.integer(baseline_years)))
  
  out <- df %>%
    mutate(Year_calendar = as.integer(.data[[year_var]])) %>%
    filter(Year_calendar %in% years)
  
  if (!is.null(drop_city_ids)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(!(.data[[id_var]] %in% drop_city_ids))
  }
  if (!is.null(keep_city_ids)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(.data[[id_var]] %in% keep_city_ids)
  }
  
  year_map <- data.frame(
    Year_calendar = years,
    Year_model = seq_along(years)
  )
  
  out <- out %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year_calendar") %>%
    mutate(
      post = as.integer(Year_calendar >= policy_year),
      Year_imp = post,
      treatment = as.integer(city_imp == 1 & post == 1),
      treated = treatment
    ) %>%
    arrange(Year_model, .data[[id_var]])
  
  if (spec == "reduced") {
    suffix <- paste0(min(baseline_years), substr(max(baseline_years), 3, 4))
    baseline_x_vars <- paste0(extended_x_vars, "_bl_", suffix)
    baseline_df <- out %>%
      filter(Year_calendar %in% baseline_years) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_var]]) %>%
      summarise(
        across(all_of(extended_x_vars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = paste0("{.col}_bl_", suffix)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(baseline_x_vars), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
    
    out <- out %>% left_join(baseline_df, by = id_var)
    x_vars <- c(core_x_vars, baseline_x_vars)
    nuisance_vars <- core_x_vars
  } else {
    x_vars <- c(core_x_vars, extended_x_vars)
    nuisance_vars <- x_vars
  }
  
  list(
    data = out,
    x_vars = x_vars,
    nuisance_vars = nuisance_vars,
    years = years,
    baseline_years = baseline_years,
    spec = spec
  )
}

fit_cf_model <- function(panel, label, outcome = outcome_var, num_trees = cf_num_trees,
                         seed = 42, tune = TRUE) {
  df <- panel$data
  x_vars <- panel$x_vars
  nuisance_vars <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- unique(c(outcome, "treatment", x_vars, nuisance_vars, id_var, "Year_model",
                        "Year_calendar", "city_imp", "post", "prov_code"))
  miss_cols <- setdiff(need_cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing columns in", label, ":", paste(miss_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  df <- df %>% filter(if_all(all_of(need_cols), ~ !is.na(.)))
  Y <- df[[outcome]]
  W <- as.numeric(df$treatment)
  X_df <- df[, x_vars, drop = FALSE]
  X <- as.matrix(scale(X_df))
  colnames(X) <- x_vars
  
  fmlY <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome, " ~ ", paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | ", id_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  fmlW <- as.formula(paste0(
    "treatment ~ ", paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | ", id_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  
  mY <- feols(fmlY, data = df)
  Y.hat <- predict(mY)
  mW <- feols(fmlW, data = df)
  W.hat <- pmin(pmax(as.numeric(predict(mW)), 0), 1)
  
  clusters <- as.integer(factor(df[[id_var]]))
  cf <- causal_forest(
    X = X,
    Y = Y,
    W = W,
    Y.hat = Y.hat,
    W.hat = W.hat,
    clusters = clusters,
    num.trees = num_trees,
    equalize.cluster.weights = TRUE,
    honesty = TRUE,
    tune.parameters = if (tune) "all" else "none",
    min.node.size = 5,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  ate <- average_treatment_effect(cf, target.sample = "treated")
  est <- unname(ate[["estimate"]])
  se <- unname(ate[["std.err"]])
  z <- est / se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  ci_lo <- est - 1.96 * se
  ci_hi <- est + 1.96 * se
  
  pred <- predict(cf)
  df$ITE <- as.numeric(pred$predictions)
  vi <- data.frame(
    Variable = colnames(X),
    Importance = as.numeric(variable_importance(cf))
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  summary <- data.frame(
    model = label,
    outcome = outcome,
    estimate = est,
    std_err = se,
    z_value = z,
    p_value = p,
    ci95_lo = ci_lo,
    ci95_hi = ci_hi,
    n_obs = nrow(df),
    n_cities = n_distinct(df[[id_var]]),
    years = paste(panel$years, collapse = ","),
    baseline_years = paste(panel$baseline_years, collapse = ","),
    forest_X = paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "),
    nuisance_controls = paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    fixed_effects = paste(id_var, "Year_model", sep = " + ")
  )
  
  list(
    label = label,
    panel = panel,
    data = df,
    X_df = X_df,
    X = X,
    x_center = attr(X, "scaled:center"),
    x_scale = attr(X, "scaled:scale"),
    Y = Y,
    W = W,
    Y.hat = Y.hat,
    W.hat = W.hat,
    clusters = clusters,
    cf = cf,
    summary = summary,
    vi = vi
  )
}

event_study_model <- function(panel, label) {
  df <- panel$data
  controls <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- c(outcome_var, "city_imp", "post", controls, id_var, "Year_model", "Year_calendar")
  df_es <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(need_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    transmute(
      id = .data[[id_var]],
      time = as.integer(Year_model),
      calendar_year = Year_calendar,
      Y = as.numeric(.data[[outcome_var]]),
      treat_city = as.integer(city_imp == 1),
      post = as.integer(post == 1),
      across(all_of(controls), as.numeric)
    ) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(T0 = ifelse(any(treat_city == 1 & post == 1), min(time[post == 1 & treat_city == 1]), NA_real_)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(k = time - T0)
  
  k_min <- suppressWarnings(min(df_es$k[df_es$treat_city == 1], na.rm = TRUE))
  k_max <- suppressWarnings(max(df_es$k[df_es$treat_city == 1], na.rm = TRUE))
  ref_k <- -1L
  ks_plot <- seq(k_min, k_max)
  ks_no_ref <- ks_plot[ks_plot != ref_k]
  event_name <- function(kk) if (kk < 0) paste0("dmin", abs(kk)) else paste0("d", kk)
  
  for (kk in ks_no_ref) {
    df_es[[event_name(kk)]] <- as.integer(df_es$treat_city == 1 & df_es$k == kk)
  }
  
  controls_within <- paste0(controls, "_within")
  for (j in seq_along(controls)) {
    df_es[[controls_within[j]]] <- resid(feols(as.formula(paste0(controls[j], " ~ 1 | id + time")), data = df_es))
  }
  
  rhs <- paste(c(sapply(ks_no_ref, event_name), controls_within, "factor(id)", "factor(time)"), collapse = " + ")
  m_es <- lm(as.formula(paste("Y ~", rhs)), data = df_es)
  Vcl <- sandwich::vcovCL(m_es, cluster = df_es$id, type = "HC1")
  
  pre_ks <- ks_plot[ks_plot < 0 & ks_plot != ref_k]
  lead_names <- sapply(pre_ks, event_name)
  lead_names <- lead_names[lead_names %in% names(coef(m_es))]
  
  wald_p <- NA_real_
  if (length(lead_names) > 0) {
    wald_res <- car::linearHypothesis(m_es, paste0(lead_names, " = 0"), vcov. = Vcl, test = "F")
    wald_p <- wald_res[2, "Pr(>F)"]
  }
  
  coef_names <- sapply(ks_no_ref, event_name)
  coefs <- stats::coef(m_es)[coef_names]
  ses <- sqrt(diag(Vcl))[coef_names]
  
  event_df <- data.frame(model = label, exposure = ks_plot, coef = NA_real_, se = NA_real_)
  event_df$coef[event_df$exposure != ref_k] <- coefs
  event_df$se[event_df$exposure != ref_k] <- ses
  event_df$coef[event_df$exposure == ref_k] <- 0
  event_df$se[event_df$exposure == ref_k] <- 0
  t0_model <- unique(df_es$time[df_es$treat_city == 1 & df_es$post == 1])
  t0_model <- min(t0_model, na.rm = TRUE)
  year_lookup <- panel$data %>% distinct(Year_model, Year_calendar)
  event_df <- event_df %>%
    mutate(
      ci_lo = coef - 1.96 * se,
      ci_hi = coef + 1.96 * se,
      Year_model = t0_model + exposure
    ) %>%
    left_join(year_lookup, by = "Year_model")
  
  p_event <- ggplot(event_df, aes(x = exposure, y = coef)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate(
      "label", x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("Wald pre-trend p = ", format.pval(wald_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)),
      hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, label.size = 0.25
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Event time (baseline = -1)",
      y = "Treatment effect on PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
      title = paste0("Event Study: ", label)
    )
  
  list(
    coefficients = event_df,
    wald = data.frame(model = label, tested_leads = paste(lead_names, collapse = " + "), p_value = wald_p),
    plot = p_event
  )
}

did_model <- function(panel, label) {
  df <- panel$data
  controls <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- c(outcome_var, "treatment", controls, id_var, "Year_model")
  df_did <- df %>% filter(if_all(all_of(need_cols), ~ !is.na(.)))
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome_var, " ~ treatment + ", paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    " | ", id_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  m <- feols(fml, data = df_did, cluster = as.formula(paste0("~", id_var)))
  ct <- coeftable(m)
  data.frame(
    model = label,
    estimate = unname(ct["treatment", "Estimate"]),
    std_err = unname(ct["treatment", "Std. Error"]),
    t_value = unname(ct["treatment", "t value"]),
    p_value = unname(ct["treatment", "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    n_obs = nobs(m),
    n_cities = n_distinct(df_did[[id_var]]),
    controls = paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    fixed_effects = paste(id_var, "Year_model", sep = " + ")
  )
}

fit_model_bundle <- function(label, years, baseline_years, spec = "reduced",
                             drop_city_ids = NULL, keep_city_ids = NULL,
                             num_trees = cf_num_trees, seed = 42,
                             include_did_event = TRUE) {
  panel <- make_panel(
    raw_data,
    years = years,
    baseline_years = baseline_years,
    spec = spec,
    drop_city_ids = drop_city_ids,
    keep_city_ids = keep_city_ids
  )
  cf_res <- fit_cf_model(panel, label = label, num_trees = num_trees, seed = seed)
  es_res <- if (include_did_event) event_study_model(panel, label = label) else NULL
  did_res <- if (include_did_event) did_model(panel, label = label) else NULL
  list(panel = panel, cf = cf_res, event = es_res, did = did_res)
}

print_bundle_results <- function(bundle) {
  invisible(bundle)
}

summarise_bundle <- function(bundle) {
  data.frame(
    model = bundle$cf$label,
    cf_att = bundle$cf$summary$estimate,
    cf_se = bundle$cf$summary$std_err,
    cf_p = bundle$cf$summary$p_value,
    did_att = bundle$did$estimate,
    did_se = bundle$did$std_err,
    did_p = bundle$did$p_value,
    event_pretrend_p = bundle$event$wald$p_value,
    n_obs = bundle$cf$summary$n_obs,
    n_cities = bundle$cf$summary$n_cities
  )
}

summarise_cf <- function(bundle) {
  data.frame(
    model = bundle$cf$label,
    cf_att = bundle$cf$summary$estimate,
    cf_se = bundle$cf$summary$std_err,
    cf_p = bundle$cf$summary$p_value,
    n_obs = bundle$cf$summary$n_obs,
    n_cities = bundle$cf$summary$n_cities
  )
}
```

# Main And Structured Robustness Models

```{r}
main_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Main CF: 2017-2020 all-X",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  seed = 42
)
print_bundle_results(main_bundle)

preperiod_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Pre-period-X CF: 2017-2020",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "reduced",
  seed = 42
)
print_bundle_results(preperiod_bundle)

full_year_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Year-extended CF: 2015-2020",
  years = 2015:2020,
  baseline_years = 2015:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  seed = 42
)
print_bundle_results(full_year_bundle)

drop2019_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Drop-2019 CF: 2017-2018 and 2020",
  years = c(2017, 2018, 2020),
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
print_bundle_results(drop2019_bundle)

structured_model_table <- bind_rows(
  summarise_bundle(main_bundle),
  summarise_bundle(preperiod_bundle),
  summarise_bundle(full_year_bundle)
)
print(structured_model_table)
print(main_bundle$event$plot)
print(preperiod_bundle$event$plot)
print(full_year_bundle$event$plot)
```

# Additional Robustness Models

```{r}
gdp_change <- raw_data %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2019, 2020)) %>%
  select(city_code, Year, gdp) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = gdp, names_prefix = "gdp_") %>%
  mutate(gdp_growth_2020 = (gdp_2020 - gdp_2019) / gdp_2019)
negative_gdp_cities <- gdp_change %>%
  filter(!is.na(gdp_growth_2020), gdp_growth_2020 < 0) %>%
  pull(city_code)

negative_gdp_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Exclude negative GDP growth cities",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  drop_city_ids = negative_gdp_cities,
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
quiet_cat(sprintf("\nNegative-GDP-growth cities excluded: %d\n", length(negative_gdp_cities)))
print_bundle_results(negative_gdp_bundle)

covid_2020 <- raw_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2020, !is.na(COVID)) %>%
  group_by(city_code) %>%
  summarise(COVID_2020 = sum(COVID, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
covid_cut <- quantile(covid_2020$COVID_2020, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
top_covid_cities <- covid_2020 %>%
  filter(COVID_2020 > covid_cut) %>%
  pull(city_code)

covid_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Exclude top decile COVID cities",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  drop_city_ids = top_covid_cities,
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
quiet_cat(sprintf("\nTop-decile COVID cities excluded: %d\n", length(top_covid_cities)))
print_bundle_results(covid_bundle)

regional_exclusion_city_lookup <- raw_data %>%
  filter(city_name %in% regional_exclusion_city_names) %>%
  distinct(city_code, city_name) %>%
  arrange(city_code)
regional_exclusion_city_ids <- regional_exclusion_city_lookup$city_code
regional_exclusion_unmatched <- setdiff(regional_exclusion_city_names, regional_exclusion_city_lookup$city_name)

regional_exclusion_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Exclude BTH-YRD-Fenwei cities",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  drop_city_ids = regional_exclusion_city_ids,
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
quiet_cat(sprintf("\nRegional policy-overlap cities excluded: %d\n", length(regional_exclusion_city_ids)))
print_bundle_results(regional_exclusion_bundle)

additional_robustness_table <- bind_rows(
  summarise_cf(negative_gdp_bundle) %>% mutate(excluded_cities = length(negative_gdp_cities)),
  summarise_cf(drop2019_bundle) %>% mutate(excluded_cities = NA_integer_),
  summarise_cf(covid_bundle) %>% mutate(excluded_cities = length(top_covid_cities)),
  summarise_cf(regional_exclusion_bundle) %>%
    mutate(
      excluded_cities = length(regional_exclusion_city_ids),
      listed_cities = length(regional_exclusion_city_names),
      unmatched_listed_cities = length(regional_exclusion_unmatched)
    )
)
print(additional_robustness_table)
```

# PSM Matched Sample

```{r}
psm_panel <- make_panel(raw_data, years = 2017:2020, baseline_years = 2017:2018, spec = "reduced")
match_covars <- c(core_x_vars, extended_x_vars)
psm_city <- psm_panel$data %>%
  filter(Year_calendar < policy_year) %>%
  group_by(city_code) %>%
  summarise(
    city_imp = max(city_imp, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(match_covars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_psm"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_psm"), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x))) %>%
  filter(if_all(ends_with("_psm"), ~ !is.na(.)))

psm_covars <- grep("_psm$", names(psm_city), value = TRUE)
psm_fit <- glm(as.formula(paste0("city_imp ~ ", paste(psm_covars, collapse = " + "))),
               data = psm_city, family = binomial())
psm_city$pscore <- predict(psm_fit, type = "response")

treated_ps <- psm_city$pscore[psm_city$city_imp == 1]
control_ps <- psm_city$pscore[psm_city$city_imp == 0]
ps_lower <- max(min(treated_ps), min(control_ps))
ps_upper <- min(max(treated_ps), max(control_ps))

treated_df <- psm_city %>%
  filter(city_imp == 1, pscore >= ps_lower, pscore <= ps_upper) %>%
  arrange(pscore)
control_df <- psm_city %>%
  filter(city_imp == 0, pscore >= ps_lower, pscore <= ps_upper) %>%
  arrange(pscore)

available_controls <- seq_len(nrow(control_df))
matched_pairs_list <- vector("list", nrow(treated_df))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(treated_df))) {
  if (length(available_controls) == 0) break
  diffs <- abs(control_df$pscore[available_controls] - treated_df$pscore[i])
  nearest_pos <- which.min(diffs)
  nearest_row <- available_controls[nearest_pos]
  matched_pairs_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    treated_id = treated_df$city_code[i],
    control_id = control_df$city_code[nearest_row],
    treated_pscore = treated_df$pscore[i],
    control_pscore = control_df$pscore[nearest_row],
    abs_diff = abs(treated_df$pscore[i] - control_df$pscore[nearest_row])
  )
  available_controls <- available_controls[-nearest_pos]
}
matched_pairs <- bind_rows(matched_pairs_list)
matched_city_ids <- unique(c(matched_pairs$treated_id, matched_pairs$control_id))

psm_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "PSM matched-sample CF",
  years = 2017:2020,
  baseline_years = 2017:2018,
  spec = "contemporaneous",
  keep_city_ids = matched_city_ids,
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
quiet_cat(sprintf("\nPSM matched pairs formed: %d\n", nrow(matched_pairs)))
quiet_cat(sprintf("PSM matched cities used: %d\n", length(matched_city_ids)))
print_bundle_results(psm_bundle)

psm_summary_table <- summarise_cf(psm_bundle) %>%
  mutate(
    matched_pairs = nrow(matched_pairs),
    matched_cities = length(matched_city_ids)
  )
print(psm_summary_table)
```

# Placebo, Falsification, And Bootstrap

```{r}
main_cf <- main_bundle$cf
data_main <- main_cf$data
X_main <- main_cf$X
cf_tuning <- main_cf$cf$tunable.params
treated_city_ids <- data_main %>%
  filter(city_imp == 1) %>%
  pull(city_code) %>%
  unique()
n_treated_cities <- length(treated_city_ids)
all_city_ids <- unique(data_main$city_code)
actual_att <- main_cf$summary$estimate

fit_cf_with_W <- function(W_local, outcome = "pm", treatment_name = "W_local",
                          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees, seed = 42) {
  df <- data_main
  df[[treatment_name]] <- as.numeric(W_local)
  if (length(unique(W_local)) < 2 || sum(W_local == 1) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                      n_obs = nrow(df), n_treated = sum(W_local == 1)))
  }
  fmlY <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome, " ~ ", paste(main_cf$panel$nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | city_code + Year_model"
  ))
  fmlW <- as.formula(paste0(
    treatment_name, " ~ ", paste(main_cf$panel$nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | city_code + Year_model"
  ))
  mY <- feols(fmlY, data = df)
  mW <- feols(fmlW, data = df)
  cf_args <- c(
    list(
      X = X_main,
      Y = df[[outcome]],
      W = as.numeric(W_local),
      Y.hat = predict(mY),
      W.hat = pmin(pmax(as.numeric(predict(mW)), 0), 1),
      clusters = main_cf$clusters,
      num.trees = num_trees,
      equalize.cluster.weights = TRUE,
      honesty = TRUE,
      tune.parameters = "none",
      seed = seed
    ),
    cf_tuning
  )
  cf_local <- do.call(causal_forest, cf_args)
  ate_local <- average_treatment_effect(cf_local, target.sample = "treated")
  est <- unname(ate_local[["estimate"]])
  se <- unname(ate_local[["std.err"]])
  data.frame(
    estimate = est,
    std_err = se,
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)),
    n_obs = nrow(df),
    n_treated = sum(W_local == 1)
  )
}

quiet_cat(sprintf("\nActual causal-forest ATT estimate: %.4f\n", actual_att))

# Placebo design 1: random group assignment while holding policy timing fixed.
B <- n_placebo
set.seed(42)
random_group_city_sets <- replicate(
  B,
  sample(all_city_ids, size = n_treated_cities, replace = FALSE),
  simplify = FALSE
)

random_group_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(B),
    function(b) {
      tryCatch({
        placebo_treated_cities <- random_group_city_sets[[b]]
        W_p <- as.numeric((data_main$city_code %in% placebo_treated_cities) & data_main$post == 1)
        fit_cf_with_W(
          W_local = W_p,
          treatment_name = "treatment_placebo",
          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
          seed = 42
        ) %>%
          mutate(iteration = b, placebo_type = "random_group")
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("Placebo iteration %d failed: %s", b, e$message))
        data.frame(iteration = b, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                   n_obs = NA_integer_, n_treated = NA_integer_, placebo_type = "random_group")
      })
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Random-assignment placebo progress (%d iterations)", B)
  )
)
random_group_results <- random_group_results %>% filter(!is.na(estimate))
random_group_percentile <- mean(random_group_results$estimate <= actual_att)
random_group_p <- mean(abs(random_group_results$estimate) >= abs(actual_att))

quiet_cat(sprintf("\nRandom-assignment placebo: %d successful iterations\n", nrow(random_group_results)))
quiet_cat(sprintf("Percentile of actual ATT: %.3f\n", random_group_percentile))
quiet_cat(sprintf("Two-sided placebo p-value: %.4f\n", random_group_p))

p_placebo <- ggplot(random_group_results, aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "lightblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = actual_att, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Distribution of placebo ATT (%d random assignments)", nrow(random_group_results)),
    subtitle = sprintf("Actual ATT = %.4f; percentile = %.3f", actual_att, random_group_percentile),
    x = "Placebo ATT estimates",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(size = 1))
print(p_placebo)
ggsave("placebo_ATT_distribution.png", p_placebo, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# Placebo design 2: randomized treatment timing for the true treated cities.
set.seed(42)
B_time_placebo <- n_placebo
placebo_year_pool <- c(2016L, 2017L, 2018L)
time_placebo_year_sets <- replicate(
  B_time_placebo,
  sample(placebo_year_pool, length(treated_city_ids), replace = TRUE),
  simplify = FALSE

quiet_cat(sprintf("\nRandomized-timing placebo progress (%d iterations)\n", B_time_placebo))

}
time_placebo_results_list <- vector("list", B_time_placebo)
for (b in seq_len(B_time_placebo)) {
  iter_start_time <- Sys.time()
  time_placebo_results_list[[b]] <- tryCatch({
    assigned_years <- time_placebo_year_sets[[b]]
    city_timing_map <- data.frame(
      city_code = treated_city_ids,
      placebo_start_year = assigned_years
    )
    placebo_start_vec <- city_timing_map$placebo_start_year[match(data_main$city_code, city_timing_map$city_code)]
    W_time_perm <- as.numeric(data_main$city_imp == 1 & data_main$Year_calendar >= placebo_start_vec)
    fit_cf_with_W(
      W_local = W_time_perm,
      treatment_name = "treatment_time_perm",
      num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
      seed = 42
    ) %>%
      mutate(iteration = b, placebo_type = "randomized_timing")
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("Randomized-timing placebo iteration %d failed: %s", b, e$message))
    data.frame(iteration = b, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
               n_obs = NA_integer_, n_treated = NA_integer_, placebo_type = "randomized_timing")
  })
  if (!quiet_output) {
    utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb_time_placebo, b)
    quiet_cat(sprintf("  iteration %d/%d finished in %.1fs\n",
                      b, B_time_placebo,
                      as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), iter_start_time, units = "secs"))))

}

  n_bootstrap,
  sample(all_city_ids, length(all_city_ids), replace = TRUE),
  simplify = FALSE
)
bootstrap_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(n_bootstrap),
    function(i) {
      sampled_cities <- bootstrap_city_sets[[i]]
      boot_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sampled_cities), function(j) {
        tmp <- data_main %>% filter(city_code == sampled_cities[j])
        tmp$boot_city_id <- j
        tmp
      }))
      panel_boot <- main_cf$panel
      panel_boot$data <- boot_df
      res <- tryCatch(
        fit_cf_model(panel_boot, label = paste0("bootstrap_", i), num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
                     seed = 42, tune = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(res)) {
        data.frame(iteration = i, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
      } else {
        res$summary %>%
          transmute(iteration = i, estimate = estimate, std_err = std_err, p_value = p_value)
      }
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Bootstrap progress (%d iterations)", n_bootstrap)
  )
)
```

# Heterogeneity

```{r}
label_map <- c(
  gdp = "GDP",
  gdp_avg = "GDP per capita",
  R_urban = "Urbanization rate",
  R_2nd = "Secondary-industry share",
  ind_growth_avg = "Industrial growth",
  industrial_particulate_emission_intensity = "Industrial PM emission intensity",
  air_pollutant_emission_intensity = "Air-pollution emission intensity",
  elec_cons_per_gdp = "Electricity use per GDP",
  R_ind_elec = "Industrial electricity share",
  ind_growth_avg_bl_201718 = "Industrial growth",
  industrial_particulate_emission_intensity_bl_201718 = "Industrial PM emission intensity",
  air_pollutant_emission_intensity_bl_201718 = "Air-pollution emission intensity",
  elec_cons_per_gdp_bl_201718 = "Electricity use per GDP",
  R_ind_elec_bl_201718 = "Industrial electricity share"
)

std_with <- function(df_mat_like, cf_res = main_cf) {
  as.matrix(sweep(sweep(df_mat_like, 2, cf_res$x_center, "-"), 2, cf_res$x_scale, "/"))
}

pdp_cf <- function(cf_res, var, ci_boot = 200, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  Xdf <- cf_res$X_df
  grid <- unique(sort(as.numeric(quantile(Xdf[[var]], seq(0.05, 0.95, length.out = 21), na.rm = TRUE))))
  all_pred <- lapply(seq_along(grid), function(k) {
    Xk <- Xdf
    Xk[[var]] <- grid[k]
    tau_hat <- predict(cf_res$cf, newdata = std_with(Xk, cf_res))$predictions
    data.frame(grid = grid[k], id = seq_along(tau_hat), tau = as.numeric(tau_hat))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  pdp <- all_pred %>%
    group_by(grid) %>%
    summarise(tau_mean = mean(tau, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ids <- unique(all_pred$id)
  boots <- replicate(ci_boot, {
    boot_ids <- tibble::tibble(id = sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE), boot_row = seq_along(ids))
    all_pred %>%
      inner_join(boot_ids, by = "id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      group_by(grid) %>%
      summarise(tau_mean = mean(tau), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pull(tau_mean)
  })
  pdp$ci_lo <- apply(boots, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  pdp$ci_hi <- apply(boots, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  pdp %>% mutate(Variable = var, Label = unname(label_map[[var]]))
}

pdp_all <- bind_rows(lapply(main_cf$vi$Variable, function(v) pdp_cf(main_cf, v)))

pdp_plots <- lapply(main_cf$vi$Variable, function(v) {
  tmp <- pdp_all %>% filter(Variable == v)
  ggplot(tmp, aes(x = grid, y = tau_mean)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), fill = "#506E91", alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(color = "#506E91", linewidth = 0.9) +
    labs(x = unname(label_map[[v]]), y = "Average policy effect")
})
p_pdp_all <- wrap_plots(pdp_plots, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(letters[3:(length(pdp_plots) + 2)]))
ggsave("Fig4_PM_calendar_main_PDP_all_variables.png", p_pdp_all, width = 13, height = 10, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

city_ite <- main_cf$data %>%
  filter(treatment == 1) %>%
  group_by(city_code, city_name, prov_code) %>%
  summarise(ATT = mean(ITE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

province_names <- c(
  `9` = "Shanghai", `10` = "Jiangsu", `11` = "Zhejiang", `12` = "Anhui",
  `14` = "Jiangxi", `17` = "Hubei", `18` = "Hunan", `22` = "Chongqing",
  `23` = "Sichuan", `24` = "Guizhou", `25` = "Yunnan", `29` = "Qinghai"
)

province_att <- city_ite %>%
  group_by(prov_code) %>%
  summarise(ATT = mean(ATT, na.rm = TRUE), n_cities = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    prov_name = unname(province_names[as.character(prov_code)]),
    region = case_when(
      prov_code %in% c(9, 10, 11, 12) ~ "YRD",
      prov_code %in% c(14, 17, 18) ~ "Midstream",

p_spatial <- ggplot(province_att, aes(x = reorder(prov_name, ATT), y = ATT, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = main_cf$summary$estimate, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Province-level ATT (ug/m3)", title = "Spatial Heterogeneity of PM2.5 Effects")

heterogeneity_table <- bind_rows(
  main_cf$vi %>%
    transmute(section = "variable_importance", item = Variable, value = Importance, n = NA_integer_),
  province_att %>%
    transmute(section = "province_ATT", item = prov_name, value = ATT, n = n_cities),
  region_att %>%
    transmute(section = "region_ATT", item = region, value = ATT, n = n_provinces)
)
print(heterogeneity_table)
```

```{r}
all_cf_summaries <- bind_rows(
  main_bundle$cf$summary,

  main_bundle$event$coefficients,
  preperiod_bundle$event$coefficients,
  full_year_bundle$event$coefficients
)

  main_bundle$event$wald,
  preperiod_bundle$event$wald,
  full_year_bundle$event$wald
)

placebo_summary <- bind_rows(random_group_results, time_placebo_results, alternative_region_results, temperature_result) %>%
  group_by(placebo_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(estimate)),
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_estimate = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_randomization = mean(abs(estimate) >= abs(actual_att), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bootstrap_summary <- bootstrap_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    sd_estimate = sd(estimate),
    ci95_lo = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci95_hi = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
    p_bootstrap = 2 * min(mean(estimate >= 0), mean(estimate <= 0))
  )
```
